Parameter
Required?
Description
name
Optional
New name for the administrator.
Read-only if the admin is
managed by directory sync.
phone
Optional
The phone number; E.164 format
recommended (i.e.
"+17345551212"). If no leading
plus sign is provided then it is
assumed to be a United States
number and an implicit "+1"
country code is prepended.
Dashes and spaces are ignored.
If this parameter is specified it
cannot be empty.
password
Deprecated
Legacy parameter; ignored if
specified. Formerly the new
password value for the
administrator.
password_change_required
Optional
Specify true  to require that
the admin pick a new password
at their next login, or false  if
no password change is required.
May not be changed to true  if
"role": "Administrator",
"status": "Active",
"webauthncredentials": [
{
"credential_name": "Touch ID",
"date_added": 1679517297,
"date_last_used": 1728064132,
"webauthnkey": "WAJ3YT0D4DMSIW9F6MVC"
}
]
}
}
POST  /admin/v1/admins/[admin_id]
the admin has external
password management enabled.
role
Optional
New role for the administrator.
One of: "Owner",
"Administrator", "Application
Manager", "User Manager",
"Security Analyst", "Help Desk",
"Billing", or "Read-only". The role
names are case-sensitive. Roles
other than "Owner" are effective
only if the customer edition
includes the Administrative
Roles feature. Read-only if the
admin is managed by directory
sync.
restricted_by_admin_units
Optional
Is this administrator restricted by
an administrative unit
assignment? Either true  or
false . Must be set to true  in
order to add the admin to an
administrative unit using the
API. Note that attempting to set
to true  for admins with the
"Owner" role results in a failure
response.
status
Optional
The desired administrator
account status. Either "Active"
or "Disabled" (case-sensitive).
Administrators with the "Owner"
role may not be disabled via API.
To clear an inactive admin's
"Expired" status, see Clear
Administrator Expiration. Read-
only if the admin is managed by
directory sync.
subaccount_role
Optional
The new role for the
administrator when accessing a
subaccount. One of: "Owner",
"Administrator", "Application
Manager", "User Manager",
"Security Analyst", "Help Desk",
"Billing", or "Read-only". The role
names are case-sensitive. Only
able to be set if the customer
edition includes the
Administrative Roles feature,
and the customer is an MSP
customer, has the Accounts API
feature, or has existing
subaccounts. If the role value is
the “Owner” role, the
subaccount role must also be
the “Owner” role.
token_id
Optional
The ID of the hardware token to
associate with the administrator.
Specify with no value to remove
any existing token assignment
for that administrator.
